item.title: Results of the Semi-Annual FX Turnover Surveys in April 2026
item.source: Bank of England, central bank news feed
item.opening: In April 2026, 25 financial institutions active in the UK foreign exchange (FX) market participated in the semi-annual turnover survey for the Foreign Exchange Joint Standing Committee (FXJSC). The survey results are summarised below. Detailed tables for the April 2026 reporting period, linked below, are available separately.
